meanings.usage: 形容少见或不普通的事物，强调稀缺性
指很久以前存在的事物，与现代相对
指古代民间传说中关于神、英雄的故事
指造成困难或不便的情况
用于停放汽车的建筑物
用于通知或警告的牌子
指行动或原因产生的结果
形容外观不美丽或不吸引人
与介词to/into连用，表示使某物变成另一种状态

meanings.meaning: 戈耳工（希腊神话中的蛇发女妖）
meanings.usage: 特指希腊神话中能将人变成石头的蛇发三姐妹
指相信某事是真的或某人的话语

examples.en: He parked his car outside the shop.
examples.zh: 他把车停在了商店外面。

phrases.usage: 表示与某人某事有麻烦或纠纷

examples.en: She has trouble with her neighbors.
examples.zh: 她和邻居有麻烦。

phrases.usage: 表示张贴、建造或竖起某物

examples.en: They put up a tent in the garden.
examples.zh: 他们在花园里搭起了帐篷。

phrases.usage: 表示变成某种状态或事物

examples.en: The water turned into ice.
examples.zh: 水变成了冰。

phrases.usage: 表示从那时起一直到现在

examples.en: He has been ill ever since last week.
examples.zh: 从上周起他就一直生病。

phrases.usage: 表示因为、由于（后接名词或代词）

examples.en: Because of the rain, we stayed at home.
examples.zh: 因为下雨，我们待在家里。

examples.en: The medicine had no effect on him.
examples.zh: 这药对他没有效果。

phrases.phrase: one of + 最高级 + 复数名词

examples.en: This is one of the most beautiful cities in the world.
examples.zh: 这是世界上最美丽的城市之一。

examples.en: I usually return home at six o'clock.
examples.zh: 我通常六点回家。

examples.en: Stars are beautiful at night.
examples.zh: 星星在晚上很美。

sentences.en: Jasper White is one of those rare people who believes in ancient myths.
sentences.zh: 贾斯珀·怀特是那种相信古代神话的稀有人物之一。

sentences.en: He has just bought a new house in the city, but ever since he moved in, he has had trouble with cars and their owners.
sentences.zh: 他刚在城里买了新房子，但自从他搬进来后，他就一直被汽车和它们的车主所困扰。

sentences.en: When he returns home at night, he always finds that someone has parked a car outside his gate.
sentences.zh: 每当他晚上回家时，他总是发现有人把车停在他家门口。

sentences.en: Because of this, he has not been able to get his own car into his garage even once.
sentences.zh: 因此，他甚至一次都没能把自己的车开进车库。

sentences.en: Jasper has put up 'No Parking' signs outside his gate, but these have not had any effect.
sentences.zh: 贾斯珀在他家门口竖起了“禁止停车”的牌子，但这些都没有任何效果。

sentences.en: Now he has put an ugly stone head over the gate.
sentences.zh: 现在他在门上放了一个丑陋的石头脑袋。

sentences.en: It is one of the ugliest faces I have ever seen.
sentences.zh: 这是我见过的最丑陋的脸之一。

sentences.en: I asked him what it was and he told me that it was Medusa, the Gorgon.
sentences.zh: 我问他那是什么，他告诉我那是美杜莎，那个戈尔贡女妖。

sentences.en: Jasper hopes that she will turn cars and their owners to stone.
sentences.zh: 贾斯珀希望她能把汽车和它们的车主变成石头。

sentences.en: But none of them has been turned to stone yet!
sentences.zh: 但他们中还没有人变成石头！

exercises.prompt: “because是连词，后接句子；because of是介词短语，后接名词或代词” 描述的是哪个语法点？
exercises.hint: because + 句子 / because of + 名词短语
options: 关系代词 who 引导的定语从句
陈述事实的过去时 (Simple Past for Facts)
现在进行时态 (Present Continuous Tense)

grammar.title: 现在完成时 (Present Perfect Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示过去发生的行为对现在造成的影响，或从过去开始一直持续到现在的动作
grammar.structure: 主语 + have/has + 过去分词
grammar.usage: 用于描述过去的经验或持续到现在的状态，常与ever since、for、already等连用

examples.en: He has just bought a new house.
examples.zh: 他刚买了一栋新房子。

examples.en: He has not been able to get his own car into his garage even once.
examples.zh: 他从未能够把自己的车停进车库。

examples.en: None of them has been turned to stone yet.
examples.zh: 他们中还没有人被变成石头。

grammar.title: 现在完成进行时 (Present Perfect Continuous Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示从过去开始一直持续到现在的动作，可能还在继续
grammar.structure: 主语 + have/has + been + 动词-ing形式
grammar.usage: 强调动作的持续性，常与ever since、for等时间状语连用

examples.en: He has been having trouble with cars and their owners.
examples.zh: 他一直和汽车及车主有麻烦。

grammar.title: because of 与 because 的区别
grammar.definition: because是连词，后接句子；because of是介词短语，后接名词或代词
grammar.structure: because + 句子 / because of + 名词短语
grammar.usage: 两者都表示原因，但语法结构不同

examples.en: Because of this, he has not been able to get his car into the garage.
examples.zh: 因为这个原因，他一直没能把车停进车库。

examples.en: He didn't come because he was ill.
examples.zh: 他没来，因为他病了。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + has/have + just + 过去分词

original.en: He has just bought a new house in the city.
original.zh: 他刚在城里买了一栋新房子。

examples.en: She has just finished her homework.
examples.zh: 她刚完成作业。

examples.en: They have just arrived at the station.
examples.zh: 他们刚到达车站。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + has/have not been able to + 动词原形

original.en: He has not been able to get his own car into his garage even once.
original.zh: 他从未能够把自己的车停进车库。

examples.en: She has not been able to sleep well lately.
examples.zh: 她最近一直睡不好。

examples.en: I have not been able to contact him.
examples.zh: 我没能联系上他。

patterns.pattern: It is one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词 + I have ever seen/met

original.en: It is one of the ugliest faces I have ever seen.
original.zh: 这是我见过的最丑陋的脸之一。

examples.en: This is one of the most interesting books I have ever read.
examples.zh: 这是我读过的最有趣的书之一。

examples.en: She is one of the kindest people I have ever met.
examples.zh: 她是我见过的最善良的人之一。

patterns.pattern: None of + 复数名词 + has/have + 过去分词 + yet

original.en: But none of them has been turned to stone yet!
original.zh: 但他们中还没有人被变成石头！

examples.en: None of the students has finished the exam yet.
examples.zh: 还没有一个学生完成考试。

examples.en: None of the letters has been replied to yet.
examples.zh: 还没有一封信被回复。
